project_type: TypeScript pnpm monorepo (Node 22 ESM). Autonomous commerce platform: worker/job loop, Shopify + Razorpay connectors, payment SDK, trust protocol (signed CTP evidence/receipts), Postgres persistence.
language: TypeScript 5.7.3 (strict, ESM, source uses extensionless .js import specifiers)
build_system: pnpm@9.15.4 workspaces (pnpm -r). ALWAYS run `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22` before any node/pnpm command. Repo lives at /root/counterX (NOT /projects/sandbox/counterX which is a DIFFERENT older clone - ignore it).
test_framework: vitest 3.0.7. DB/creds-gated tests use `const d = process.env['X'] ? describe : describe.skip`. Real-API tests MUST follow this skip-without-creds pattern.
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm build 2) pnpm test (baseline was 2711; after FEAT-001 it is 2731; creds-gated suites must SKIP cleanly with no creds) 3) pnpm depcruise (no violations).
setup_instructions: cd /root/counterX && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Node 22.23.2, pnpm 10.28.1 available.
environment_constraints: Network is OPEN to the real APIs: counter-commerce-agent.myshopify.com and api.razorpay.com both return HTTP 401 (reachable, auth required). Real e2e verification IS feasible when creds present. Credentials arrive ONLY via env vars at runtime - NEVER hardcode, echo, log, or commit them. DATABASE_URL points at live Supabase Postgres. SANDBOX TOOLING NOTE: fs_write/read_file operate on a per-turn snapshot overlay; bash/git/pnpm/vitest operate on the real /root/counterX disk. Write source files so they land on the real disk (bash heredoc, or fs_write then bash cp). Task-state .agents files must be written via bash to persist on disk.
key_patterns: PaymentProvider port (packages/payment-sdk/src/provider.ts) returns typed outcomes; DO NOT collapse to try/catch->failed. Preserve explicit outcomes: action_required, authorized, captured, pending, declined, INDETERMINATE (timeout/unknown), canceled, refunded, provider_unavailable. Shopify order ActionPorts (packages/shopify-connector/src/order-actions.ts) already implement timeout->indeterminate and per-idempotencyKey caching. Razorpay provider (packages/razorpay-adapter/src/razorpay-provider.ts) talks through RazorpayHttpPort but ONLY MockRazorpayHttp exists - a REAL fetch-based RazorpayHttpPort must be built (Basic auth keyId:keySecret, base https://api.razorpay.com/v1, idempotency header on POST). Shopify createHttpGraphQLClient exists (http-graphql-client.ts) with SSRF validation but no env factory. Worker main.ts wires a deterministic in-process stand-in via PaymentAuthorizationPort; transaction-lifecycle.ts documents a per-transactionId IDEMPOTENCY CONTRACT a live connector MUST honor. depcruise: apps MAY import packages; packages must NOT import apps; merchant packages must NOT import @counter/data/pg/drizzle (worker is an app so it may import @counter/data AND connectors). Credential helper from FEAT-001: apps/worker/src/connector-env.ts.
directory_structure: apps/worker = durable Postgres job loop (index.ts testable surface, main.ts entrypoint, transaction-lifecycle.ts handler, connector-env.ts credential helper). packages/shopify-connector = Shopify Admin GraphQL adapter (real http-graphql-client.ts + mock-graphql-client.ts, 7 order ActionPorts, quote-service, catalog-sync, auth). packages/razorpay-adapter = Razorpay provider (razorpay-provider.ts implements PaymentProvider through RazorpayHttpPort; only MockRazorpayHttp today). packages/payment-sdk = PaymentProvider port + CounterTestPaymentProvider (deterministic, CTP-signed) + contract harness. scripts/ = repo-level node .mjs scripts. packages/trust-protocol = CTP envelope signing for receipts/evidence.
